summary.pages_overview: PortfolioManagement is a complex portfolio optimization interface with 5 functional tabs (Alpha, Sector, Model, Trade, History). The Trade tab features an AG Grid with 33 columns and inline editing capabilities. All tabs receive pre-calculated optimization data from the backend Lambda (opal-pm-optimization-loader). The page supports two auto-save mechanisms: legacy trade-based auto-save and new optimization-state auto-save (both 60-second intervals). Users can upload PKL/XLSX files directly via presigned S3 URLs, resume from auto-save, and export portfolio data for submission.
summary.data_flow: Fund selection (usePortfolioStore) → Fetch auto-save (useAutoSaveQuery) → Upload files or Resume session → Load optimization data from backend (usePortfolioData) → Initialize useOptimizationState with securities, factors, sectors, model data → User edits in Trade tab → Auto-save every 60s (useOptimizationAutoSave) → Export or submit version
summary.key_architecture: Central state hook (useOptimizationState) manages all portfolio optimization data. Each tab receives sliced data (securities, alphaFactors, sectorAllocations, modelCoefficients, riskFactors) and passes back callbacks for updates. Legacy Zustand store (usePortfolioStore) handles fund/account selection and session metadata. AG Grid component is the most complex UI element with 33 columns, selection, and inline editing.
